visual_identity.body: Slender, segmented torso with a distinct 'wasp waist'; smooth, high-fidelity chitin textures with soft, rounded edges to remain child-friendly.
visual_identity.coloration: Deep iridescent blue-black with subtle amber highlights on the joints.
visual_identity.wings: Four translucent, shimmering wings with delicate vein patterns; rendered with high-quality specular highlights.
visual_identity.face: Large, expressive compound eyes with a friendly, soulful glint; short, non-aggressive antennae.

anatomy_constraints: Must maintain a recognizable wasp silhouette while avoiding sharp, needle-like points or aggressive stingers to suit the target audience.
personality: Alert, industrious, and helpful; moves with quick, zippy, but controlled flight paths.
